summary: MasterCraft Boat Holdings filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 via Exhibit 99.1. The disclosure relates to the previously completed two-step merger with Marine Products Corporation under a February 5, 2026 agreement, first reported on a May 15, 2026 8-K and amended June 12, 2026. No new deal terms, price, premium, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or closing conditions are stated. The filing exists solely to make pro forma financials available for incorporation into future registration statements.
